name: io.github.Runeeward/runeward
description: Agent governance harness with Docker/Kubernetes Citadels, policy, Conclave approvals, budgets, and signed Chronicles.

runtimeArguments.description: Start the runeward MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory to resolve profile TOML files from (optional; defaults to the standard search path).

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where the tamper-evident Chronicle (audit ledger) is written (optional).

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_AUTHZ_FILE
environmentVariables.description: 0600 JSON principal configuration for multi-user RBAC.

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_MCP_DEFAULT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token selecting the principal for this stdio MCP process; `runeward auth login` is the local alternative.

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_OIDC_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: OIDC issuer used to verify signed workload JWTs.

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_OIDC_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Required audience for OIDC workload JWTs.

environmentVariables.name: RUNEWARD_COPY_FROM_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated roots permitted for administrator copy_from operations.
